notes.title: BIG ANNOUNCEMENT: our new game is...Goodnight Universe
notes.notes:
Hello to our Before Your Eyes players! It's been a minute, but we have some HUGE news: 

WE'VE JUST ANNOUNCED OUR NEXT GAME: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416100/Goodnight_Universe/]GOODNIGHT UNIVERSE [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36762339/ada93f20ae2ec286f233ee9e0a32ae93d45cffae.jpg[/img]

If you loved Before Your Eyes, then this is for you:

You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.

Coming 2025...

🍼Be a baby
🌀Use psychic powers
💽Escape an evil tech company
🫂Mend a disconnected family

And we're super honored to announce that we'll be demoing a small slice of the game in competition at Tribeca Festival this summer. 

Please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416100/Goodnight_Universe/]WISHLIST NOW![/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416100


And follow us to keep up to date with announcements and updates :) 

[url=https://twitter.com/nicedreamgames]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/nicedreamgames/]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@nicedreamgames]TikTok[/url]

The loving reception that BYE received from players was something we could have never predicted, and it changed the lives of all of us on the dev team. From the tattoos, to the poetic and hilarious Steam reviews, to the BAFTA we won, every piece of support we receive means the world to us. You all are what made us brave enough to make another game, and we really cannot wait to share it with you! 

- The BYE Team

Best,

The GoodbyeWorld Games team

notes.title: PATCH 1.2.6.2 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 
first of all, thank you for being here with us and all your feedback we've gotten so far. We love hearing your opinions on the game and the experience you had with [b]Before Your Eyes[/b], so keep them coming! 
 
We try to read all your posts on the forum and help out on the spot while taking notes for the patching work we do.
The first patch is now live and here's the list of changes it includes: 
 
[b]GRAPHICS[/b] – there was an issue with the game’s visuals appearing blurry for some players on lower spec PC's. After the patch, BYE should run with higher FPS and without blurriness on a bigger amount of lower or below-minimum spec machines. That said, if playing on a low spec computer, it is still important to use the lowest graphics settings, and lower resolution settings, in order to have a smooth experience. 
 
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b] – we heard you when you said the “the “non-detection” mode and “on-screen camera feed” feature were not as easily accessible as they could be.. We’ve changed that and both modes can now be toggled in the main menu.  
 
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b] –  we’ve added a new chapter point towards the end of the game, titled "Pain." 
 
[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]:
[list]
[*] Black screens on low spec machines should no longer occur
[*] More cameras should now be more easily detected and used
[*] Addressed the reported Steam achievement issues 
[*] Include webcam overlay during credits
[*] Other minor changes and fixes
[/list]
 
Thank you for being here with us and your amazing support!
 
 
- The BYE Dev Team

notes.title: Launch Day Notice
notes.notes:
[b]The launch day of Before Your Eyes is a big day for our team![/b]

After many years of work our game which you play just by blinking is finally here but as more and more players get to try our new style of gameplay for themselves, we discovered an issue that may affect those trying to play with the graphics set to high on lower-end PCs.

It seems that playing Before Your Eyes on a lower spec PC with graphics and/or resolution set on HIGH can result in lower framerates or stuttering and this, in turn, may cause blurriness, black screen or poor blink detection.

The team is working on this, but in the meantime, we recommend that if you are playing on a lower spec computer you should avoid playing on high graphics and resolution settings.  We encourage you to experiment with lowering them, to make sure they are appropriate for the computer’s specification.

In the case of Before Your Eyes, setting the graphics too high right now can cause issues beyond low framerate that would hinder your enjoyment of the game. We apologize for this and we hope for your understanding.

Please let us know what you think of our game in the forum and in the reviews – we’d love to hear what you have to say!

--BYE Team
